title: Why Safe Investors Settle for WORSE Returns (Collar Strategy)
text: That's the whole point of the collar. It's more of a sleep at night kind of thing. You do not need to outperform the market to the upside every year to do well. If you outperform the market during really bad years, notice how long it took buy and hold to catch up to the collar that had dampened this. But, there's a give and take. What's the take? If this doesn't happen in your sample, then you're going to do much, much worse. So, without this kind of massive shock to the system, the collar is going to continue to underperform more and more. That's by design. The point there is you're sacrificing this upside so that if this happens, you do not participate to the downside anywhere near to the same degree.
